001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.cb;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI.ShipPickMode;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.FleetTypes;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithBarEvent;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetQuality;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetSize;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerNum;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerQuality;
015
016public class CBDeserter extends BaseCustomBountyCreator {
017
018        @Override
019        public float getFrequency(HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, int difficulty) {
020                if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(mission.getPerson().getFaction().getId())) return 0f;
021                return super.getFrequency(mission, difficulty) * CBStats.DESERTER_FREQ;
022        }
023        
024        public String getBountyNamePostfix(HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, CustomBountyData data) {
025                return " - Deserter";
026        }
027        
028        @Override
029        public CustomBountyData createBounty(MarketAPI createdAt, HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, int difficulty, Object bountyStage) {
030                CustomBountyData data = new CustomBountyData();
031                data.difficulty = difficulty;
032                
033//              mission.requireSystemTags(ReqMode.ANY, Tags.THEME_RUINS, Tags.THEME_MISC, Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SECONDARY,
034//                                                                Tags.THEME_DERELICT, Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED);
035                mission.requireSystemInterestingAndNotUnsafeOrCore();
036                mission.requireSystemNotHasPulsar();
037                if (difficulty <= 3) mission.preferSystemInInnerSector();
038                StarSystemAPI system = mission.pickSystem();
039                data.system = system;
040        
041                FleetSize size = FleetSize.MEDIUM;
042                FleetQuality quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
043                String type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
044                OfficerQuality oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
045                OfficerNum oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
046                
047                FactionAPI faction = mission.getPerson().getFaction();
048                
049                if (difficulty <= 4) {
050                        size = FleetSize.SMALL;
051                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
052                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
053                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
054                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL;
055                } else if (difficulty <= 5) {
056                        size = FleetSize.MEDIUM;
057                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
058                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
059                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
060                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
061                } else if (difficulty == 6) {
062                        size = FleetSize.LARGE;
063                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
064                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
065                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
066                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
067                } else if (difficulty == 7) {
068                        size = FleetSize.LARGE;
069                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
070                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
071                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
072                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
073                } else if (difficulty == 8) {
074                        size = FleetSize.VERY_LARGE;
075                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
076                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
077                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
078                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
079                } else if (difficulty == 9) {
080                        size = FleetSize.HUGE;
081                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
082                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.HIGHER;
083                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
084                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
085                } else {
086                        size = FleetSize.MAXIMUM;
087                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
088                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.HIGHER;
089                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
090                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
091                }
092                
093                beginFleet(mission, data);
094                mission.triggerCreateFleet(size, quality, faction.getId(), type, data.system);
095                mission.triggerSetFleetOfficers(oNum, oQuality);
096                mission.triggerAutoAdjustFleetSize(size, size.next());
097                mission.triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
098                mission.triggerFleetSetShipPickMode(ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL);
099                
100                mission.triggerFleetSetNoFactionInName();
101                if (faction.getEntityNamePrefix() == null || faction.getEntityNamePrefix().isEmpty()) {
102                        mission.triggerFleetSetName("Deserter");
103                } else {
104                        mission.triggerFleetSetName(faction.getEntityNamePrefix() + " Deserter");
105                }
106                
107                mission.triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
108                mission.triggerPickLocationAtInSystemJumpPoint(data.system);
109                mission.triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation(null, null);
110                //mission.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(data.system);
111                mission.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(data.system, true, Tags.JUMP_POINT, Tags.SALVAGEABLE, Tags.PLANET);
112                data.fleet = createFleet(mission, data);
113                if (data.fleet == null) return null;
114                
115                setRepChangesBasedOnDifficulty(data, difficulty);
116                data.baseReward = CBStats.getBaseBounty(difficulty, CBStats.DESERTER_MULT, mission);
117                
118                return data;
119        }
120        
121
122        @Override
123        public int getMaxDifficulty() {
124                return super.getMaxDifficulty();
125        }
126
127        @Override
128        public int getMinDifficulty() {
129                return 4;
130        }
131
132}
